summary: This clinical trial is testing the drug tirzepatide in patients who have obesity and a common type of chronic liver disease called Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatotic Liver Disease, or MASLD. The study aims to learn how the drug affects markers related to this liver condition over a period of 12 months. Researchers are currently Recruiting a target of 8 participants between the ages of 18 and 75. The study sponsor is the University of New Mexico.
